mentions.name: Self-hosted container deployment platform
mentions.description: A platform for deploying containerized workloads across your own servers, designed to scale with a smooth developer experience from a single $5 server up to 200 servers, with zero-downtime migrations. It has no control plane—every node is equal and eventually consistent—and is written end-to-end in Rust for a minimal per-node footprint.
mentions.problem: Existing self-hosted deployment tools like Coolify have single-server limitations, and scaling or migrating workloads between servers typically requires downtime.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a project for deploying containerized workloads across your own servers, but with great dx from starting on a $5 server to migrating/scaling to 200 servers (no downtime required for any migrations).
